scenes: Original children's picture book in torn-paper collage with soft pastel shading, autumn russet, teal and cream. No imitation of any named artist, no lettering or numbers. Same characters in every scene: white rabbit with long pink inner ears and teal waistcoat, girl with black bob and mustard overalls, boy with brown curls and rust sweater. Gentle grassy hill weather station with autumn leaves, wooden observation table and blue sky with small white clouds. Exactly 2 columns by 2 rows equal square panels, thin straight white gutters. Top left BEFORE: puzzled rabbit looks at red-white windsock on short pole while holding blue rain-symbol flag, children look up at dry blue sky, comic confusion. Top right AFTER: rabbit and children smile beside weather instruments after realizing moving windsock shows wind, not rain; rabbit gives a small souvenir rabbit-shaped windsock on wooden stand to girl. Bottom left spare closeup souvenir: cream rabbit-shaped fabric windsock with two long pink-lined ears and teal streamers extending horizontally from a small brass pole on wooden round base. Bottom right HOST: friendly white rabbit portrait wearing teal waistcoat, autumn leaves behind. Whole subjects inside each cell.
